\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-31},
  title = {The data contract is a hand-written \texorpdfstring{\texttt{schema.\allowbreak{}py}}{schema.py}},
  date = {2026-09-29},
  milestone = {M2: Reproducibility},
  topic = {Data Validation, Testing Strategy},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {\texttt{recommenditos/\allowbreak{}schema.\allowbreak{}py} holds the structural contract of the raw, interim and processed frames: column names, dtypes and nullability, with a \texttt{validate} and a \texttt{conform} method.
Value rules stay in the Great Expectations suites.
Every stage validates after reading and conforms before writing.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Pandera: a third validation system next to Great Expectations and Pydantic, and it does not check the datetime unit.
\item Great Expectations alone: the contract would live only in a generated store, and the stage tickets needed something to code against before that ticket.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} A structural break is a bug in our code and should fail the stage that caused it.
A value break is a change in the data and belongs in a suite with a tolerance.
\texttt{conform} casts to the declared dtypes before each write, because Parquet keeps whatever dtype it is handed.
It also selects only the contract's columns, which keeps the personal-data columns out of later frames.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI installed Pandera, Great Expectations and pyarrow against our pandas version and measured what survives a Parquet round trip.
Two findings decided the option: a string dtype that changes across the boundary, and Pandera ignoring the datetime unit.
Lukas chose from the three options with these findings.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-09-29, probes in a scratch environment.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/recommenditos/schema.py}{\texttt{schema.\allowbreak{}py}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/tests/test_schema.py}{\texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}schema.\allowbreak{}py}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/32}{issue \#32}.},
